title: Bring your parents 3 weeks in a row.
title2: The 4th week, they dine on us!
sub: They counted every rupee so that we never had to. Give them a table, a smile and your time.
steps: Make it three in a row
punch: Roots feed the tree. Honour yours.
terms: Parents aged 60+ · dine-in only · Monday to Friday, at a time that suits them · register your family at the counter · management reserves the right to amend
